rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Deduction
rules.statement: The system must immediately deduct reserved quantities from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot upon automatic order assignment.
rules.condition: when an order is automatically assigned to a Store Partner
rules.if_violated: The business risks overselling items and incurring immediate refund liabilities.
rules.rationale: Preventing overselling ensures accurate inventory representation and protects customer trust.

parameters.name: reservation_timeout
parameters.description: maximum duration a reservation holds inventory before release

rules.name: Revenue Share Accuracy
rules.statement: The system must calculate the revenue share percentage for a Financial Transaction Record using the pre-defined commission rate applicable to the specific Store Partner category.
rules.condition: when finalizing a Financial Transaction Record
rules.if_violated: The business faces financial disputes, regulatory non-compliance, and partner churn.
rules.rationale: Ensuring precise financial distribution maintains trust and adheres to contractual obligations.

parameters.name: commission_rate
parameters.description: percentage of transaction value allocated to the Platform Operator

rules.name: Performance Metric Threshold
rules.statement: A Store Partner may only maintain active status if their calculated quality score remains above the minimum acceptable threshold.
rules.condition: when generating the Real-Time Store Partner Performance Dashboard
rules.if_violated: The partner is restricted from receiving new orders until performance improves.
rules.rationale: Maintains service quality standards and protects the customer experience.

parameters.name: minimum_quality_score
parameters.description: lowest acceptable score to retain active status

rules.name: Settlement Timing
rules.statement: Financial settlement funds must not be transferred to the Store Partner until a valid Delivery Proof is recorded and verified.
rules.condition: when initiating the Financial Settlement Handover confirmation
rules.if_violated: The business risks paying for undelivered goods and losing revenue control.
rules.rationale: Ensures funds are only released upon successful fulfillment of the service obligation.

parameters.name: settlement_delay_window
parameters.description: maximum time allowed between proof verification and fund transfer
